description: 한국공항공사 광주공항 여객 차량 유입지역 정보 [airports] (series on Public Data Portal (data.go.kr)) is a series of datasets listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국공항공사. 한국공항공사(Korea Airports Cooperation)는 인천국제공항을 제외한 전국 14개 공항을 운영하는 공공기관입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 한국공항공사. Its tags are 광주공항 유입지역, 광주공항 여객 연령대, 광주공항 유입 시군구, 광주공항 유입 읍면동, 광주공항 활용 지역. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
